decision.observation: Floor 6 loaded as an elite fight against three Sentries (42, 41, and 44 HP). Only the center intends 10 damage; the hand has two Strikes, Defend, Inflame, and unplayable Ascender’s Bane.
decision.hypothesis: Playing Inflame first, then both Strikes on the left Sentry, should maximize damage while setting up its removal before the outer Sentries attack together.
decision.memory: Map travel resolved: the plain elite above the ringed enemies was the actual available node. Inflame costs 1 and grants 2 Strength for combat; each Strike should then deal 8 damage.
